title: Zesty Roasted Punjabi Lamb Curry
description: A delicious and flavorful Indian-inspired curry made with roasted lamb, featuring a cheesy pull and a twist of hoisin sauce. Perfect for a lazy Sunday dinner.

ingredients.name: Garlic paste
ingredients.notes: Mince the garlic and make paste

ingredients.name: Hoisin sauce
ingredients.notes: For a sweet and savory flavor

ingredients.name: Red chili powder
ingredients.notes: Adjust to taste for heat level

ingredients.name: Cumin powder
ingredients.notes: For a warm and earthy flavor

ingredients.name: Coriander powder
ingredients.notes: For a citrusy and slightly sweet flavor

ingredients.name: Garam masala
ingredients.notes: For an aromatic and slightly sweet flavor

ingredients.name: Mozzarella cheese
ingredients.notes: For a melty and creamy texture

instructions: Rinse the lamb shoulder and pat it dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together the ginger paste, garlic paste, hoisin sauce, yogurt, red chili powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, salt, and garam masala.
Rub the marinade all over the lamb shoulder, making sure it's evenly coated.
Place the lamb shoulder in a large Dutch oven or oven-safe pot and cover it with a lid.
Roast the lamb in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
While the lamb is roasting, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb shoulder to the skillet and sear it for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and roast the lamb for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until it's tender and falls apart easily.
While the lamb is cooking, heat the mozzarella cheese in the microwave for 10-15 seconds, or until it's melted and stretchy.
To assemble the curry, place a portion of the roasted lamb on a hot stone plate, followed by a spoonful of the melted mozzarella cheese.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve immediately.
